visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short dark hair and glasses, wearing a white lace-patterned cardigan over a white collared shirt, sits on a brown leather couch in a professional studio setting. She is speaking directly to the camera with calm facial expressions, her hands resting in her lap. The background features soft, vertically pleated curtains illuminated by warm, ambient indoor lighting. (2) The scene transitions to a medical animation showing a cross-section of skin tissue. A thin green medical instrument (Accutite) is inserted beneath the dermis, emitting a red glow representing radiofrequency energy. (3) A close-up shot shows a handheld medical device (Morpheus8) being pressed against a patient's cheek skin, leaving temporary grid-like indentations. (4) The woman is shown again, gesturing with her right hand toward her face to emphasize her points. (5) A montage of facial treatment shots follows: one showing a Thermage device applied near the eye area of a patient lying down, and another showing eye surgery prep or laser treatment (MLP) on a person wearing protective eye shields. (6) The woman returns to the frame, pointing her finger forward toward the viewer as she delivers a final recommendation. (7) The video concludes with a clean white static screen displaying the clinic's logo, contact phone number, social media handle, and physical addresses.
